title: This AI workflow replaced my notebook entirely.
author: Sufficient_Net_4138
selftext:
Step one: record the lecture on your phone. Just leave it on the 

    desk — that's it.

    Step two: transcribe it. Free AI tools do this in minutes.

    Step three: paste the transcript into AI and say "make me a study 

    guide."

    Step four: "quiz me one question at a time, critique my answers" — 

    now it's testing you like a tutor.

    Step five: "convert this to Anki format" — paste into Anki, done.

    One lecture just became notes, a quiz, and a full flashcard deck. 

    You never have to handwrite notes again.

     Follow for more.
